importer: restore candidate update from manual search and ID prompts (#7005)

## Description

Fixes #7000.

In commit `d143e2cb`, `Proposal` was moved to `if TYPE_CHECKING:` in
`beets/ui/commands/import_/session.py`. As part of that typing refactor,
the runtime handling for `Proposal` return values from prompt choice
callbacks was removed from both `TerminalImportSession.choose_match()`
and `choose_item()`.

As a result, when an interactive importer user chose `e` ("Enter
search") or `i` ("enter Id"), `manual_search` or `manual_id`
successfully fetched matching candidates and returned a `Proposal`, but
the return value was dropped, leaving the active import task with the
stale pre-lookup candidates list.

## Solution

1. Import `Proposal` at runtime from `beets.autotag`.
2. Restore the `if isinstance(post_choice, Proposal):` assignment branch
in both `choose_match()` and `choose_item()`:
   ```python
   task.candidates = post_choice.candidates
   task.rec = post_choice.recommendation
   ```
3. Add end-to-end regression test in `test/ui/test_ui_importer.py`
verifying that manual search updates `task.candidates` and applies the
chosen manual candidate.

## Change

- derive each MusicBrainz track's `medium_total` from the tracks
remaining after
  data/video filtering
- extend the existing data/video matrix to assert the reported medium
total for
  every configuration

## Why

Video tracks live in MusicBrainz's normal track list, so filtering them
left
`medium_total` at the original unfiltered count. Data tracks are
represented
separately, which produced inconsistent metadata for the two equivalent
ignore
options. Reporting the filtered count keeps the candidate's per-medium
metadata
consistent with the tracks Beets actually imports.

## Checks

- `uv run ruff check beetsplug/musicbrainz.py
test/plugins/test_musicbrainz.py`
- `uv run pytest -q test/plugins/test_musicbrainz.py` (55 passed)

Fixes #6836

index bb6ced1..4f8c091 100644
--- a/src/click/_termui_impl.py
+++ b/src/click/_termui_impl.py
@@ -638,6 +638,11 @@ def _tempfilepager(
         f.close()
         subprocess.call([str(cmd_path), f.name])
     finally:
+        # An error raised while paging skips the close() above, and Windows
+        # refuses to unlink a file the process still holds open. Closing here
+        # keeps that PermissionError from replacing the original exception.
+        # close() is idempotent, so this is a no-op on the success path.
+        f.close()
         os.unlink(f.name)

+    exception raised while the pager is open used to skip it and reach

fix(reinstall): propagate returned failures in reinstall-all (#2043)

`reinstall-all` currently discards errors returned by `reinstall()`, so
refusing to use an interpreter inside the target environment still
produces exit code 0 and a successful JSON result.

Collect returned errors and only record successfully reinstalled
environments. Add CLI regressions for complete and partial failure, and
document the exit behavior.

Fixes #2042

Validation: full test suites on Python 3.14 and 3.10; reinstall tests on
the other supported Python versions; `tox run -e type,lint,docs,man`.

### Thanks for contributing, make sure you address all the checklists
(for details on how see [development
documentation](https://pipx.pypa.io/latest/contributing.html))

- [x] ran the linter to address style issues (`pre-commit run
--all-files`)
- [x] wrote descriptive pull request text
- [x] ensured there are test(s) validating the fix
- [x] added news fragment in `changelog.d/` folder (choose a type:
`feature`, `bugfix`, `doc`, `removal`, or `misc`)

fix(graph_store): stop logging Neptune SigV4 auth headers at INFO (#1373)

* fix(graph_store): stop logging Neptune SigV4 auth headers

NeptuneAuthTokenManager logged the full signed auth info JSON — the
SigV4 Authorization header and X-Amz-Security-Token — at INFO level on
every token generation. Together these are a live, replayable AWS
credential, so any log sink readable at the default INFO level received
working Neptune credentials for the STS token's TTL.

Replace the log line with a DEBUG message that carries no credential
material, and add a regression test asserting the signed headers never
reach the auth logger at any level.

Fixes #1365

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(graph_store): cover X-Amz-Security-Token in auth log regression test

Review feedback: the mock credentials had token=None and MockSigV4Auth
never emitted X-Amz-Security-Token, so a regression that logged only the
STS session token would have passed. Give the mocked credentials a
sentinel session token for this test, have MockSigV4Auth add the
X-Amz-Security-Token header when a token is present (matching real
SigV4Auth), and assert the sentinel never appears in captured logs.
